purpose: Test one-step goal-directed action selection against matched action alternatives.

protocol.objective_evaluation: evaluate J(s_next,g) for every candidate action using the same state, goal and noise realization
protocol.selection_rule: choose action with maximal predicted J; ties resolved by smallest absolute action

controls.anti_goal_control: choose action maximizing distance from g

metrics.secondary: fraction of decisions with maximal available objective among candidates

interpretation_rule: PASS establishes only one-step goal-directed action selection in this synthetic system. It does not establish planning, reasoning, self-model, intelligence, cognition, or biological equivalence.
